data.title: Police under fire over missing case updates
data.description: Police in Chon Buri have apologised to the families of three Thai murder victims for failing to provide regular updates on the investigation, while insisting officers continued working on the case and remain committed to bringing those responsible to justice.

data.title: Dugong's death 'unclear'
data.description: Phuket: Marine scientists were unable to determine the exact cause of death of a juvenile male dugong found washed ashore in Phang Nga's Takua Thung district on Friday, as the carcass was in an advanced state of decomposition.

data.title: Anutin begins key visit to Indonesia
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will begin an official visit to Indonesia on Monday, the first by a Thai PM to the country in 15 years, the government said.

data.title: NSB expands probe into Japan meth smuggling
data.description: The Narcotics Suppression Bureau (NSB) is expanding its investigation into a suspected transnational drug trafficking network after Japanese prosecutors decided not to pursue charges against a Thai woman arrested over methamphetamine hidden in coffee sachets she carried to Japan.

data.title: Govt reviews power deals
data.description: The government is reviewing long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs) with private producers as part of efforts to lower electricity prices, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt said on Sunday.

data.title: Japan's Kuwaki wins women's British Open to clinch first major title
data.description: LYTHAM ST ANNES (UNITED KINGDOM) - Japan's Shiho Kuwaki won the women's British Open in a dramatic play-off with Esther Henseleit on Sunday, securing her first major title in memorable style.

data.title: Rescuers recover climber Nirmal Purja's body after avalanche disaster
data.description: SKARDU (PAKISTAN) - Rescuers recovered the body of renowned climber Nirmal Purja on Sunday after an avalanche killed him and nine team members on one of the world's highest peaks in northern Pakistan, the Alpine Club of Pakistan said.

data.title: At Nepal school, outpouring of grief for climber Nirmal Purja
data.description: CHITWAN (NEPAL) - As rescuers recovered the body of climbing legend Nirmal Purja on Sunday, grief rippled hundreds of kilometres away in Nepal at the school where he first displayed the grit that would make him world-famous.

data.title: OPEC+ boosts September production by 188,000 barrels/day
data.description: LONDON - Saudi Arabia, Russia and five other key members of OPEC+ agreed in an online meeting Sunday to boost oil production by 188,000 barrels a day from September, against a backdrop of disruption caused by the Mideast war.

data.title: Trump's on-again-off-again war against Iran: in his own words
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Donald Trump has made some of the most aggressive public threats about military action of any modern US president. He has walked back many of them too.

data.title: Brazil's Lula, 80, says 'in great shape' as he launches fourth term bid
data.description: SAO PAULO - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, 80, said Sunday he was "in great shape" as he launched his candidacy for October elections, with pressure from US President Donald Trump's administration looming over the campaign.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ramadan Ondash rejects Ghazali rematch, tells Aliff ‘come to flyweight’
data.description: Ramadan Ondash has rejected an immediate rematch with Johan Ghazali and told former conqueror Aliff Sor Dechapan to follow him to flyweight as he targets ONE Championship gold – preferably in Qatar.

data.title: Two police killed, 3 wounded in Narathiwat plantation firefight
data.description: NARATHIWAT - A manhunt was launched for an armed suspect after two Tak Bai police investigators were killed and three others wounded during a drug search in Tak Bai district on Sunday.

data.title: Suspect who exposed serial-murders gang now in witness protection
data.description: A murder suspect who told police there may be additional victims of the gang that killed two Russian siblings and a Thai family of three has been placed under witness protection, according to an informed source.

data.title: Fire toll mounts in Greece as blazes spread
data.description: PORTO GERMENO (GREECE) - Greece on Sunday faced multiple fronts and a growing damage toll with wildfires believed to have devastated swathes of forest and agricultural land, and the prime minister warning of "extremely difficult" days ahead.

data.title: At least 72 died in Spain's Ceuta migrant rush
data.description: CEUTA (SPAIN) - At least 72 people died during last week's mass influx of migrants into Spain's Ceuta enclave, when tens of thousands of people mostly swam around the border post from Morocco, local officials said on Sunday.

data.title: Greater Bangkok property market splits as condos gain
data.description: Kiatnakin Phatra data show condos and more affordable homes outperforming in Greater Bangkok as costly detached houses and new shophouses weaken.

data.title: Woman courier cleared of drug smuggling in Japan returns home
data.description: A Thai woman courier suspected of smuggling drugs into Japan has returned to Thailand after convincing Japanese prosecutors she was unaware that crystal methamphetamine was hidden in coffee sachets in a package she carried for a client.

data.title: Police raid illegal Myanmar pub in Bangkok
data.description: Eleven Myanmar nationals, one a young teenager, were caught with ketamine at an illegal pub in Wang Thonglang district, Bangkok, raided by police early Sunday morning. The Thai proprietor was also arrested.

data.title: Thai choral festival to feature 21 choirs
data.description: The annual Thailand International Choral Festival begins on Monday and concludes on Friday at the Thailand Cultural Centre in Bangkok, with performances from 21 Thai and international choirs under this year's theme of "Sabai Sabai".

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali wants Ondash rematch ‘today’ – and tells rival to buy new mouthguard
data.description: Johan Ghazali has called for an immediate rematch with Ramadan Ondash in ONE Championship – and told his rival to invest in a better mouthguard before they meet again.

data.title: Thailand rebuts UN rapporteur's border conflict claims
data.description: Thailand has rebutted claims by a United Nations human rights expert on the impact of the Thai-Cambodian border conflict, disputing figures he cited on displaced Cambodians and migrant workers returning from Thailand.

data.title: Embankment bursts, floods homes in Phetchabun
data.description: PHETCHABUN - Floodwater inundated about 150 houses in Lom Sak district of this northern province after an embankment of the Pasak River burst late Saturday night.

data.title: Alleged gunman ‘took his own life’ after temple murder
data.description: A man is believed to have killed himself in a rented flat under seige by police after allegedly shooting another man dead and wounding two others at a temple in Bangkok.

data.title: Trump says will hold off on fresh Iran attack in hope of quick deal
data.description: CAIRO - US President Donald ‌Trump said late on Saturday he would hold off on a fresh attack on Iran as long as a deal could be reached quickly to halt Iran's nuclear ambitions and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

data.title: Two severely injured in pickup plunge from elevated expressway
data.description: A man and a girl were seriously injured when their pickup truck crashed through a barrier and plummeted from an elevated expressway in Ratchathewi district, Bangkok, early Sunday morning.

data.title: Capital misallocation keeps Thailand below growth potential
data.description: Bank of Thailand Governor Vitai Ratanakorn says capital misallocation is holding back growth and urges data-led lending to widen SME access to finance.

data.title: Two severely injured when their pickup plunged from elevated expressway
data.description: A man and a girl were seriously injured when their pickup truck fell from an elevated expressway in Ratchathewi district, Bangkok, early Sunday morning.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 2
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: PM vows irrigation for farmers
data.description: Irrigation development will speed up nationwide to help increase farmers' incomes and reduce the impact of recurring floods and droughts, says Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

data.title: US embassies urge citizens to consider departing Middle East
data.description: DUBAI - US embassies in capitals across the Middle East on Saturday warned American citizens to beware of an "unforeseen escalation" in the regional conflict and urged them to be ready to leave.

data.title: Thai ICF 2026 to feature 21 choirs
data.description: The annual Thailand International Choral Festival is set to take place from Monday until Friday at the Thailand Cultural Centre in Bangkok, with performances from 21 Thai and international choirs under this year's theme of "Sabai Sabai".

data.title: Lumpini Park puts smart parking to test
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) will begin testing a new smart parking management system at Lumpini Park in September as part of efforts to ease chronic parking congestion and improve convenience and safety for park visitors.

data.title: Thailand Riviera coastal drive gets tourism push
data.description: Regional authorities are stepping up efforts to promote the Thailand Riviera coastal route as a major tourism corridor, as part of plans to improve public awareness, enhance visitor facilities and spread tourism income to communities along the Gulf of Thailand's western coastline.

data.title: Cabinet backs faster removal of foreigners
data.description: A cabinet-backed draft regulation will allow authorities to remove foreigners whose conduct is deemed incompatible with Thai morals and social norms, Deputy Prime Minister for Legal Affairs Pakorn Nilprapunt said.

data.title: Appetite grows for Talay Noi swamp buffalo meat
data.description: PHATTHALUNG: A research-driven initiative to develop premium meat products from naturally raised swamp buffalo in the Talay Noi wetlands is gaining traction, with demand growing locally and from China.

data.title: Jude's new Port of call as forward eyes trophies
data.description: Thai-English forward Jude Soonsup-Bell said he believes in Port's potential after joining the Thai League 1 giants from English league.

data.title: Korat business leaders push elevated transit plan
data.description: Business leaders in Nakhon Ratchasima have urged authorities to replace the proposed ground-level Orange Line light rail transit (LRT) project in Muang district with an elevated rubber-tyred electric transit system, saying it would be safer, cheaper and better suited to the province.
